name: Random walk
doc: A wandering 0..1 signal that takes a seeded random step each grid unit (the last 16 steps summed, folded into 0..1), gliding between them. Seeded by the tick and the scene, so every host walks the same path.

step.doc: 1 on the first tick of each step

glide.doc: fraction of a step spent sliding to the new value
